qualification: Seats are positions authorized, filled or vacant: 677 district positions (48 vacant), 345 bankruptcy judgeships authorized and funded (63 vacant), and 593 magistrate judge positions (567 full time, 24 part time, 2 combined with a clerk’s post), all as of September 30, 2025. The statute tables list 673 district and 316 bankruptcy judgeships; the courts’ counts also take in temporary judgeships, which the tables leave out. No appointing president or party is recorded.

notes: Statute tables summed by script: 28 U.S.C. 133(a) lists 673 district judgeships, four of them shared between districts; 152(a)(2) lists 316 bankruptcy judgeships, and its notes carry temporary judgeships
The courts’ 677 district positions against the table’s 673 is not traced seat by seat; temporary judgeships are the likely difference and are not confirmed here
